entries.title: Unsighted

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete game in a native release with PC capture/settings flexibility. The Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox versions are documented access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy UNSIGHTED on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.
